ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 3 day of November, 2023, by and between Bronx Estates 1 LLC, having an address at 183 Wilson Street, Suite 510, Brooklyn NY 11211, in its capacity as owner of Block 3278,Lot 6 ("Owner"), and Bronx Estates 1 LLC, having an address at 183 Wilson Street, Suite 510, Brooklyn NY 11211, in its capacity as owner of Block 3278, Lot 5 (*Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties").
